packageRules.description: Group the Rust dependencies so one pull request moves the lockfile once rather than several fighting over it.
forge-ci and the actions are pinned to a tag's full commit SHA on purpose, and moving one is an explicit decision. Renovate may propose it; it may not batch it with anything else.
The Rust toolchain is pinned in rust-toolchain.toml and a bump changes which clippy lints exist, so it is never automatic.
